# Obtain Notifier

![Obtain Notifier function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/synchronization/notifier/obtain.svg)

[Synchronization functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Obtains an anonymous empty Notifier&lt;T&gt;, or an additional handle to a same-context named notifier with the exact full type. The type specimen is not sent. An absent name with create if not found=False is an error.

## Product execution profiles

The shared index declares native examples for this object; see [the examples below](obtain.md#examples) and [document profiles and evidence boundaries](../../../reference/studio-draft-examples.md). Older binding/help statements retained below can lag those product profiles. They do not establish or deny the separately measured native profiles. An example declaration alone is not an execution result or admission of every overload.

Obtient un Notifier&lt;T&gt; anonyme vide ou un accès supplémentaire à un notificateur nommé du même contexte et de même type complet. Le spécimen de type n’est pas envoyé. Un nom absent avec create if not found=False produit une erreur.

## Types and connection rules

Notifier&lt;T&gt; is a nominal typed synchronization resource. Preserve the full invariant T schema. Multiple results add an outer rank-1 array; when T is itself an array, wrap each full message in cluster&lt;notification:T&gt; (explicit FROG v1 contract).

- Type resolution: `custom_resolver`; result expression: `resolve:frog.studio.synchronization.notifier.type-resolution@1`.
- Implicit coercion: not enabled by this resolver; individual port policies remain explicit.
- Arrays: accepted; lifting policy: `none`.

Preserve each message as one complete T. No element-wise lifting, flattening, implicit Variant or rectangular padding. Multiple wraps array-valued T in cluster&lt;notification:T&gt;.

**Input count:** 4; this contract does not enable variadic inputs.

Port order: `element_type` → `name` → `create_if_not_found` → `error_in`.
